usedFor: QuestionScout builds forms and surveys, and “New Submission” starts a template when an answer arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in QuestionScout, then “Create Person” in toflow.ai
bestTemplate.why: Each submission adds the respondent as a person elsewhere, so answers do not sit in a form.

watchOut: Anything a submission starts that reaches the respondent waits in Needs you for your approval.
